theory.title: Challenge 4.2: Communication Log Parser
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "This is real-world log processing, PROTO-7. Parse messy text, extract structured data, filter by criteria, generate reports. Every production system needs log analysis."

Complete Text Processing Pipeline

Production log parsing requires:

  • Cleaning: Strip whitespace, normalize format
  • Parsing: Split delimited text into fields
  • Extraction: Get specific data from positions
  • Normalization: Convert case, standardize values
  • Structuring: Convert text to dicts/lists
  • Filtering: Find logs matching criteria
  • Reporting: Format output for humans

⚠️ Challenge Architecture

  • Input: 5 raw log strings (messy, inconsistent)
  • Cleaning: Strip String on full log and each field
  • Parsing: Split String by '|' delimiter
  • Normalization: Convert To Upper Case for level
  • Structuring: Create Dictionary for each log
  • Storage: Suite variable @{PARSED_LOGS} shared across tests
  • Filtering: FOR + IF to find ERROR logs
  • Reporting: String concatenation for formatted output

Real-World Applications

This challenge demonstrates patterns used in:

  • Log aggregation and analysis systems
  • ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines
  • Data cleaning and normalization
  • Report generation from raw data
  • API response parsing and formatting

You've mastered String library—essential for all text processing automation.
